description_en: Restores a quarantined file from the quarantine
description_zh: 取消对文件隔离箱中文件的隔离
name: RollbackSuspEventQuaraFile

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the request
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the quarantined file. You can call [DescribeSuspEventQuaraFiles](~~DescribeSuspEventQuaraFiles~~) to obtain this value from the Id field in the response. This parameter is required. If this parameter is not specified, the API returns HTTP 400 with error code -101.

Before you call this operation, make sure that the Security Center agent is installed on the ECS instance, and that file-related security events and corresponding quarantined files exist. After a file is quarantined, call DescribeSuspEventQuaraFiles to query the quarantined file ID, and then call this operation to restore the file
parameters.help_zh:
隔离文件 ID。可调用 [DescribeSuspEventQuaraFiles](~~DescribeSuspEventQuaraFiles~~) 获取，使用返回的 Id 字段值。本参数必填；未提供时，API 返回 HTTP 400，错误码为 -101。

调用前，ECS 实例需安装云安全中心客户端，并已有文件类安全事件及对应的隔离文件。完成文件隔离后，通过 DescribeSuspEventQuaraFiles 查询隔离文件 ID，再调用本接口回滚
parameters.name: quara_file_id

parameters.help_en: The source of the request. Set the value to sas
parameters.name: from

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the member account in the resource directory.
You can call [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
资源目录成员账号主账号 ID。
调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
